<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>MaxiTodo Caballito — Rojas 8284</title>
<style>
:root{
  --navy:#0e2438; --navy-2:#132f4a; --paper:#f4f1ea; --paper-2:#ffffff;
  --ink:#16202b; --muted:#5c6b78; --teal:#147d70; --teal-dark:#0d5c52; --line:#dcd6c8;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --paper:#12181f; --paper-2:#1a212b; --ink:#eef1f3; --muted:#9aa7b0; --line:#2a3340;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --paper:#12181f; --paper-2:#1a212b; --ink:#eef1f3; --muted:#9aa7b0; --line:#2a3340;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:-apple-system,"Inter","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.45;}
h1,h2,h3,.brand{font-family:Georgia,"Iowan Old Style",serif;letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
a{color:inherit;} img{max-width:100%;display:block;}

header.site{background:var(--navy);color:var(--paper);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;border-bottom:3px solid var(--teal);padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);}
.header-inner{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;}
.brand{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.brand span{color:var(--teal);}
.brand-logo{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0;}
.search-box{flex:1;max-width:440px;display:flex;}
.search-box input{flex:1;border:none;padding:10px 14px;font-size:.95rem;border-radius:2px 0 0 2px;outline:none;}
.search-box button{border:none;background:var(--teal);color:#fff;padding:0 16px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:0 2px 2px 0;}
.header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;}
.icon-btn{background:none;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);color:#fff;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.85rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap;}
.icon-btn:hover{border-color:var(--teal);}
.cart-count{background:var(--teal);color:#fff;border-radius:50%;width:20px;height:20px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;}

.catbar{background:var(--navy-2);overflow-x:auto;}
.catbar-inner{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;display:flex;gap:4px;}
.catbar button{background:none;border:none;color:#c9d3da;padding:10px 14px;font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.02em;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;}
.catbar button.active,.catbar button:hover{color:#fff;border-color:var(--teal);}

.hero{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 24px 24px;}
.hero h1{font-size:2.1rem;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--ink);}
.hero p{color:var(--muted);max-width:60ch;margin:0;}
.hero .note{margin-top:14px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);background:var(--paper-2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 14px;display:inline-block;border-radius:2px;}

.grid-wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 24px 80px;}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:22px;}
.card{background:var(--paper-2);border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:box-shadow .15s ease, transform .15s ease;}
.card:hover{box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(14,36,56,.10);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.card .thumb{aspect-ratio:1/1;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;}
.card .thumb img{max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;}
.card .body{padding:14px 16px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1;}
.card .marca{font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--teal);font-weight:700;}
.card .nombre{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);min-height:2.6em;}
.card .desc{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);flex:1;}
.card .precio{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);margin-top:6px;}
.card .stock{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);}
.card .add-btn{margin-top:8px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border:none;padding:10px;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer;border-radius:2px;}
.card .add-btn:hover{background:var(--teal-dark);}
.card .add-btn:disabled{background:#8a9299;cursor:not-allowed;}

.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(14,36,56,.45);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s ease;z-index:30;}
.overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;}
.drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;height:100%;width:min(420px,100%);background:var(--paper-2);z-index:40;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .25s ease;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);}
.drawer.open{transform:translateX(0);}
.drawer-head{padding:20px 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
.drawer-head h2{margin:0;font-size:1.2rem;}
.drawer-head button{background:none;border:none;font-size:1.4rem;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);}
.drawer-items{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:14px 22px;}
.cart-item{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.cart-item img{width:56px;height:56px;object-fit:contain;background:#fafafa;border:1px solid var(--line);}
.cart-item .info{flex:1;}
.cart-item .info .nombre{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;}
.cart-item .qty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:6px;}
.cart-item .qty button{width:24px;height:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper-2);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;}
.cart-item .remove{background:none;border:none;color:#c0503f;font-size:.75rem;cursor:pointer;margin-top:4px;padding:0;}
.drawer-foot{padding:18px 22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
.drawer-foot .total{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:12px;}
.checkout-btn{width:100%;padding:14px;background:#25D366;color:#0e2438;border:none;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border-radius:2px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;text-decoration:none;}
.checkout-btn:hover{filter:brightness(.95);}
.checkout-btn[disabled],.checkout-btn.disabled{background:#8a9299;color:#fff;pointer-events:none;}
.checkout-note{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px;}
.empty-cart{color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:40px 0;font-size:.9rem;}

footer{background:var(--navy);color:#c9d3da;padding:32px 24px;margin-top:40px;font-size:.82rem;padding-bottom:calc(32px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));}
.footer-inner{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;}
.no-results{padding:60px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);}
@media (max-width:720px){ .header-inner{flex-wrap:wrap;} .search-box{order:3;max-width:100%;} }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="site">
  <div class="header-inner">
    <a href="#" class="brand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="MaxiTodo Caballito - Rojas 8284" class="brand-logo"> MaxiTodo Caballito</a>
    <div class="search-box"><input id="search-input" type="text" placeholder="Buscar productos, marcas..."></div>
    <div class="header-actions">
      <button class="icon-btn" id="open-cart">Carrito <span class="cart-count" id="cart-count">0</span></button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <nav class="catbar"><div class="catbar-inner" id="catbar"></div></nav>
</header>

<section class="hero">
  <h1>Electrodomésticos y más, con envío a todo el país</h1>
  <p>Elegí los productos que te interesan y consultanos el precio por WhatsApp, al toque.</p>
  <div class="note">💬 Precios y stock actualizado, a un mensaje de distancia.</div>
</section>

<main class="grid-wrap"><div class="grid" id="grid"></div></main>

<footer><div class="footer-inner"><span>© MaxiTodo Caballito — Rojas 8284. Todos los derechos reservados.</span></div></footer>

<div class="overlay" id="overlay"></div>
<aside class="drawer" id="drawer">
  <div class="drawer-head"><h2>Tu carrito</h2><button id="close-cart">&times;</button></div>
  <div class="drawer-items" id="drawer-items"></div>
  <div class="drawer-foot">
    <a class="checkout-btn disabled" id="checkout-btn" target="_blank" rel="noopener">📲 Consultar precio por WhatsApp</a>
    <div class="checkout-note">Te respondemos con los precios y el link de Mercado Pago para pagar con tarjeta, efectivo o dinero en cuenta.</div>
  </div>
</aside>

"Multistyler GH18 1100 Dry&Style System 5en1", "descripcion": "Seca y peina con un solo movimiento, 5 accesorios incluidos, aire frío.", "stock": 9, "imagen": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"}, {"id": "11", <script>
const WHATSAPP_NUMBER = "5491172201986";
const PRODUCTS = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('products-data').textContent);

const state = { cart: [], category: 'Todos', query: '' };
const fmt = n => new Intl.NumberFormat('es-AR', { style:'currency', currency:'ARS', maximumFractionDigits:0 }).format(n);

function renderCategories(){
  const cats = ['Todos', ...new Set(PRODUCTS.map(p=>p.categoria))];
  const bar = document.getElementById('catbar');
  bar.innerHTML = cats.map(c=>`<button data-cat="${c}" class="${c===state.category?'active':''}">${c}</button>`).join('');
  bar.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ state.category = btn.dataset.cat; renderCategories(); renderGrid(); });
  });
}

function filteredProducts(){
  return PRODUCTS.filter(p=>{
    const matchCat = state.category==='Todos' || p.categoria===state.category;
    const q = state.query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matchQ = !q || p.nombre.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.marca.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.categoria.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    return matchCat && matchQ;
  });
}

function renderGrid(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('grid');
  const list = filteredProducts();
  if(list.length===0){ grid.innerHTML = '<div class="no-results">No encontramos productos con esos filtros.</div>'; return; }
  grid.innerHTML = list.map(p=>`
    <div class="card">
      <div class="thumb"><img src="${p.imagen}" alt="${p.nombre}" loading="lazy"></div>
      <div class="body">
        <div class="marca">${p.marca||''}</div>
        <div class="nombre">${p.nombre}</div>
        <div class="desc">${p.descripcion||''}</div>
        <div class="stock">${p.stock>0 ? p.stock+' disponibles' : 'Sin stock'}</div>
        <button class="add-btn" data-id="${p.id}" ${p.stock<=0?'disabled':''}>${p.stock<=0?'Sin stock':'Agregar y consultar precio'}</button>
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');
  grid.querySelectorAll('.add-btn').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>addToCart(btn.dataset.id)));
}

function addToCart(id){
  const existing = state.cart.find(i=>i.id===id);
  if(existing) existing.cantidad+=1; else state.cart.push({id,cantidad:1});
  render(); openDrawer();
}
function changeQty(id,delta){
  const item = state.cart.find(i=>i.id===id); if(!item) return;
  item.cantidad += delta;
  if(item.cantidad<=0) state.cart = state.cart.filter(i=>i.id!==id);
  render();
}
function removeFromCart(id){ state.cart = state.cart.filter(i=>i.id!==id); render(); }

function render(){ renderCartCount(); renderDrawer(); }

function renderCartCount(){
  document.getElementById('cart-count').textContent = state.cart.reduce((a,i)=>a+i.cantidad,0);
}

function renderDrawer(){
  const wrap = document.getElementById('drawer-items');
  const btn = document.getElementById('checkout-btn');
  if(state.cart.length===0){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-cart">Tu carrito está vacío.</div>';
    btn.classList.add('disabled'); btn.removeAttribute('href');
    return;
  }
  let lineas = [];
  wrap.innerHTML = state.cart.map(item=>{
    const p = PRODUCTS.find(pr=>pr.id===item.id); if(!p) return '';
    lineas.push(`• ${item.cantidad}x ${p.nombre}`);
    return `
      <div class="cart-item">
        <img src="${p.imagen}" alt="${p.nombre}">
        <div class="info">
          <div class="nombre">${p.nombre}</div>
          <div class="qty">
            <button data-act="dec" data-id="${p.id}">−</button>
            <span>${item.cantidad}</span>
            <button data-act="inc" data-id="${p.id}">+</button>
          </div>
          <button class="remove" data-id="${p.id}">Quitar</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
  const mensaje = `Hola! Quiero consultar precio y disponibilidad de estos productos:%0A%0A${encodeURIComponent(lineas.join('\n'))}%0A%0AMe pasás precios y el link de pago de Mercado Pago?`;
  btn.href = `https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${mensaje}`;
  btn.classList.remove('disabled');

  wrap.querySelectorAll('[data-act="inc"]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click', ()=>changeQty(b.dataset.id,1)));
  wrap.querySelectorAll('[data-act="dec"]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click', ()=>changeQty(b.dataset.id,-1)));
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.remove').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click', ()=>removeFromCart(b.dataset.id)));
}

function openDrawer(){ document.getElementById('overlay').classList.add('open'); document.getElementById('drawer').classList.add('open'); }
function closeDrawer(){ document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('open'); document.getElementById('drawer').classList.remove('open'); }

document.getElementById('overlay').addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
document.getElementById('open-cart').addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
document.getElementById('close-cart').addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
document.getElementById('search-input').addEventListener('input', e=>{ state.query = e.target.value; renderGrid(); });

renderCategories();
renderGrid();
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
